data.title: [OrbiPom! MERGE!] Fun & Games Event Details
data.brief: ▼// Event Time Oct. 1, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance ▼// Event
data.data:
▼// Event Time

Oct. 1, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance


▼// Event Rewards

Complete missions during the event to earn event rewards including [Oroberyls] and [T-Creds].


▼// Participation Requirements

Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process II: Paving the Way]


▼// Event Details

· Go to the web event, merge OrbiPoms of the same type to get bigger OrbiPoms and earn points, then claim generous rewards.


※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5

※ For more event details, check the in-game [Event Center].
